text:
alex: Morning folks — async ops update (KMS/IAM).
alex: What I did: ran staging KMS rotation dry-run, updated rotation runbook (added manual rollback steps).
alex: Blockers: CI service account missing iam:Decrypt on kms-decrypt role, rotation stops at step 3. @sara can you confirm role owner? Also scanner flagged a package vuln.
alex: Today: patch role, re-run rotation, open PR for runbook + add audit annotation.

engsec-bot: [auto] vuln-scan: new finding CVE-2026-1234 in repo infra/crypto (low -> med). Link: https://internal/scan/3389 — triage advised.

sara: I can take the IAM patch. Will push a fix by 11:30 PT and ping infra on approver.
mike: For rollout, prefer a short maintenance window at 12:30-13:00 PT. @alex can you do canary in prod after staging passes?
judy: Add a note to the runbook to check CloudTrail events `Decrypt` count — I saw one missing metric yesterday.
sam: I'll review the PR once it's up. quick heads-up: CI may need to be re-triggered after role change.
alex: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/452 — includes policy diff:
```
- "Action": "kms:Decrypt" -> not present
+ "Action": "kms:Decrypt"
```
alex: Thanks all — will update here when staging rotation finishes. :thumbsup:
engsec-bot: [auto] rotation-run: staging rotation completed with warnings (kv-cache mismatch). See logs: https://internal/logs/rotations/452
sara: saw logs, will check kv-cache mismatch, might be unrelated to IAM.
mike: if kv-cache mismatch is persistent, fallback plan is to skip KV flush and rotate keys 1/3 at a time.
judy: filing a small follow-up ticket for audit annotation: https://tracker/RED-238
sam: Reviewed PR, left 2 nits. LGTM after fixes.
alex: merged and kicked full rotation. Closing loop here — thanks team. :rocket:
